description: Add conditional visibility to the editor button in the context menu so it only appears during development mode. Currently, the editor button remains visible after building the presentation, but becomes non-functional. This feature should align the context menu behavior with the existing navigation controls.
functional_requirements: Extend the ContextMenuOption type definition to include an optional 'show' boolean field
Modify the context menu configuration to set the editor button's 'show' field based on the __DEV__ flag
Update the context menu component to conditionally render menu items using v-if based on the 'show' field
